decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The English cue and Indonesian answer are sound, but Malaysian “vest” is not the best Malay learner answer. Standard Malay references give “rompi” for this garment and “ves” as an adapted form; “vest” is primarily an English spelling. The proposed contrast is therefore misleading, and no false-friend contrast is established. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
